lines.text: በዘጠነኛ ክፍል በጋ ወደ ሳሙኤል ቤት እየሄድኩ ነበር።
lines.en: That summer in Grade Nine, I was walking to Samuel's house.

lines.text: ፀሐያማ ከሰዓት ነበር። ሁሉም ነገር ሰላም ይመስል ነበር።
lines.en: It was a sunny afternoon. Everything felt normal.

lines.text: ድንገት ከኋላዬ የፈጣን እግር ድምፅ ሰማሁ።
lines.en: Suddenly, I heard heavy footsteps rushing behind me.

lines.text: ሁለት ሰዎች መንገድ ዘጉብኝ። በጣም ደነገጥኩ።
lines.en: Two guys cornered me. I was terrified.
They took my things and ran off.

lines.text: በተቻለኝ ፍጥነት ወደ ደህና ቦታ ደረስኩ።
lines.en: I got somewhere safe as fast as I could.

lines.text: ሳሙኤል ተጨንቆ ነበር። ለሳምንታት አልተነጋገርንም ነበር።
lines.en: Samuel had been worried. We hadn't talked in weeks.

lines.text: እንዲሁ ፍርሃታችን ወደ አስቂኝ ጨዋታ ተቀየረ።
lines.en: And just like that, fear turned into our favorite story.

lines.en: Wait, what?! Only you could turn that into a wild story!
